@deskSetRescanComplete.description: Settings > Recheck balance: line added to the scan log when the scan ended normally.

@deskSetRescanStoppedLine.description: Settings > Recheck balance: line added to the scan log when the scan was stopped; also the title of the result card.

@deskSetRescanLog.description: Settings > Recheck balance: title of the collapsible scan log and its screen reader label.

deskSetRescanText: Checks the chain again for this wallet’s coins. Use it when the balance looks wrong.

@deskSetRescanText.description: Settings > Recheck balance: text of the first row.

@deskSetRescanRecheck.description: Button on Settings › Recheck balance that starts the recheck (the phone's Recheck).

@deskSetRescanRecheckAgain.description: The same button after a recheck ended or failed.

@deskSetRescanFromDate.description: Choice on Recheck balance (Advanced › Recheck from a height): start from the block of a chosen date.

@deskSetRescanPickDate.description: Button under From a date that opens the date picker.

@deskSetRescanPickDateFirst.description: Error when Recheck is pressed with From a date chosen and no date picked.

deskSetRescanDeleteHint: Also cancels unconfirmed transactions and unlocks their outputs. A payment already on its way may then fail.

@deskSetRescanDeleteHint.description: Settings > Recheck balance: small text under the Delete unconfirmed checkbox.

deskSetRescanScanning: Scanning the chain. The wallet stays usable; the balance updates when the scan ends.

@deskSetRescanScanning.description: Settings > Recheck balance: text while a scan runs.

@deskSetRescanStopping.description: Settings > Recheck balance: progress line after Stop was pressed.

@deskSetRescanChecking.description: Settings > Recheck balance: progress line with the percentage done.

@deskSetRescanFailed.description: Settings > Recheck balance: title of the error notice when the scan failed.

@deskSetRescanNoneFound.description: Settings > Recheck balance: result sentence after Delete unconfirmed found nothing.

deskSetRescanCancelled: Unconfirmed transactions were cancelled and their outputs unlocked.

@deskSetRescanCancelled.description: Settings > Recheck balance: result sentence after Delete unconfirmed.

@deskSetRescanNotRead.description: Settings > Recheck balance: shown instead of a balance that could not be read.

@deskSetRescanFinished.description: Settings > Recheck balance: title of the result card after a complete scan.

deskSetRescanUpToDate: The balance is up to date.

@deskSetRescanUpToDate.description: Settings > Recheck balance: first sentence of the result after a complete scan. Further sentences follow after a space.

deskSetRescanResumed: The scan carried on from where it stopped; the counts cover that part.

@deskSetRescanResumed.description: Settings > Recheck balance: result sentence after a resumed scan; follows another sentence after a space.

deskSetRescanStoppedEarly: Stopped before the end. The balance was read again; start again to carry on.

@deskSetRescanStoppedEarly.description: Settings > Recheck balance: first sentence of the result after a stopped scan. A further sentence may follow after a space.

deskSetRescanNotDeleted: Unconfirmed transactions were not deleted: that runs only when a scan completes.

@deskSetRescanNotDeleted.description: Settings > Recheck balance: result sentence after a stopped scan with Delete unconfirmed; follows another sentence after a space.

@deskSetRescanBefore.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a fact in the result card.

@deskSetRescanAfter.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a fact in the result card.

@deskSetRescanFound.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a count in the result card. An output is a coin unit in the wallet.

@deskSetRescanRestored.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a count of restored outputs in the result card.

@deskSetRescanRevived.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a count of outputs that became spendable again in the result card.

@deskSetRescanUnlocked.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a count of unlocked outputs in the result card.

@deskSetRescanDeleted.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of a count of deleted outputs in the result card.
